description: DLR Road Traffic Special Speed Limit Bye Laws 2024 is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. In 2024, a countywide speed limit review was carried out in Dun Laoghaire Rathdown in line with “Guidelines for Setting and Managing Speed Limits in Ireland”, issued by the Department of Transport, Tourism and Sport. Coverage: Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Its tags are DLR, DLRCC, Dun Laoghaire-Rathdown, Traffic Management Roads and Transportation, Traffic management. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, KML, SHP.ZIP, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
